description: On desktop, quick ask's box (the ask window, HAL-18787) may hide itself through plugin:quick-ask|hide, on Esc or a click beside the box. The command takes nothing and hides only the calling window, and is refused from any other. It may also show Messenger's window on a chat through plugin:quick-ask|open_chat (HAL-18961), for Open in Messenger, Answer in Messenger and Last answer: the command takes only the chat's ID, does nothing else with it, hides the box once Messenger shows, and is refused from any other window. The box can't read or change its keys, and no page can register a key or hear one. It is local only, so the Studio the computer serves gets nothing.
